description:
This schematic map illustrates the land cover and land use (LULC) types within a typical coastal lagoon landscape, using a colour-coded legend and CORINE Land Cover (CLC) type numerical codes. The map features a large central light blue area labelled "8.3.1 Lagoons", representing a "Coastal lagoon". This lagoon is separated from the "Sea and Ocean" (dark blue, labelled "8.4.2 Coastal waters") by a narrow land barrier. This barrier comprises a yellow "Sand bank" and dark olive green "Vegetated dunes", which are collectively labelled "6.2.1 Beaches and Dunes". Orange arrows indicate connections or flows across this barrier.

Inland from the lagoon, there are large light green areas labelled "2.1.1 Arable irrigated and non-irrigated land". The legend identifies the light green as "Rice" and a paler green/white as "Irrigated land"; both types fall under the "2.1.1 Arable irrigated and non-irrigated land" classification. Adjacent to the vegetated dunes and other arable land, a dark green area is labelled "3.2.1 Other natural & semi-natural coniferous forest", which corresponds to "Pine" in the legend. A small light green patch, classified as "5.3 Sclerophyllous scrub", is also present inland.

The legend provides the following colour-to-land cover type mapping:
*   Light blue: Coastal lagoon
*   Yellow: Sand bank
*   Dark olive green: Vegetated dunes
*   Dark green: Pine
*   Light green: Rice
*   White/Pale green: Irrigated land
*   Dark blue: Sea and Ocean
